terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.subtitle: Please review the terms that apply to using this website, registering for events, payments, refunds, cookies, and privacy.

general.title: General use
general.intro: These terms apply to visitors, registered crews, boat representatives, and anyone using the official Regatta Port Bourgas website or event registration services.

paymentProvider.title: Payment provider
paymentProvider.text: Online payments are processed through <mypos>myPOS</mypos>. The website supports online payments via various payment methods made available by myPOS during checkout.

points.title: Acceptance of terms
points.text: By using the website, submitting an event registration, uploading documents, or completing a payment, you agree to follow these terms and any official event documents published by the organizers.

points.title: Event information
points.text: Programmes, entry fees, schedules, classes, notices, entry lists, and results may be updated when needed. Official notices and event documents take priority for event-specific instructions.

points.title: Registration responsibility
points.text: Registrants are responsible for providing accurate boat, skipper, crew, contact, insurance, and payment information. The organizers may reject or request correction of incomplete, inaccurate, or unsuitable submissions.

points.title: Participant conduct
points.text: Participants must follow applicable sailing rules, safety requirements, harbour rules, organizer instructions, and standards of fair sporting behaviour during the event.

points.title: Website availability
points.text: We aim to keep the website available and accurate, but temporary interruptions, maintenance, or corrections may occur. The website may not be used for unlawful activity, interference with the service, or misuse of published information.

refund.title: Refund and Cancellation
refund.intro: Refunds are possible only when there is a reasonable cause and only after approval by the event organizers. If a refund is granted, participation for that boat is no longer possible for the refunded entry.

points.title: Refund requests
points.text: A refund request should be sent to the organizers with the registration details, payment reference, and the reason for the request. Cancellation may be requested up to 5 business days after the payment has been completed. Reasonable causes may include duplicate payment, administrative error, documented inability to attend, or an organizer-approved event change.

points.title: Organizer approval
points.text: All refunds are reviewed case by case. A refund is not automatic and is valid only when expressly approved by the event organizers.

points.title: Effect of refund
points.text: Once a refund is approved or processed, the related registration and payment are treated as cancelled. The boat may not participate in the event under that refunded entry.

points.title: Processing
points.text: Approved refunds are returned to the payment account within 5 to 7 business days after confirmation from the organizers. Bank, card, payment provider, currency conversion, or processing fees may affect the final amount or timing.

points.title: Event cancellation or changes
points.text: The organizers may cancel, postpone, shorten, or modify an event for safety, weather, operational, legal, or other substantial reasons. Any available refund, transfer, or credit options will be communicated by the organizers.

privacy.title: Cookies and Privacy
privacy.intro: We use limited personal data and cookies to operate the website, manage registrations, communicate with participants, and support event administration.

points.title: Cookies
points.text: The website may use essential cookies for core functions such as language preference, consent choices, security, and session behaviour. Optional cookies may be used for analytics or performance where consent is required.

points.title: Information we collect
points.text: For event registration and administration, we may collect boat details, skipper and crew information, contact details, nationality, club information, insurance documents, payment status, and messages sent through the website.

points.title: How information is used
points.text: Information is used to process registrations, prepare entry lists and event documents, verify payment and insurance status, send operational notices, support safety procedures, and meet administrative or legal obligations.

points.title: Payments
points.text: Payment details are handled by the payment provider. We may store payment status, payment identifiers, amounts, and related references, but we do not store full card details on this website.

points.title: Sharing and retention
points.text: Information may be shared with event organizers, race officials, service providers, or authorities when needed for event operation, safety, compliance, or support. Data is retained only for as long as reasonably necessary for these purposes.

points.title: Your choices
points.text: You may contact the organizers to request correction, access, or deletion of personal information where applicable. Some information may need to be retained for payment, safety, legal, or event record purposes.

regatta-2025-announcement.title: International Regatta Port Bourgas Bulstrad Cup  2025 - Registration Open
regatta-2025-announcement.description: We are excited to announce that registration for the 2025 International Regatta Port Bourgas Bulstrad Cup  is now open. Join us for an unforgettable sailing experience.
regatta-2025-announcement.body:
The International Regatta Port Bourgas Bulstrad Cup  2025 promises to be an exceptional event with participants from around the world. Early registration is recommended as spots are limited. The regatta will feature multiple classes and categories, ensuring competitive racing for all skill levels.

Key highlights:
- Multiple racing classes
- Professional race management
- Social events and networking opportunities
- Awards ceremony

Registration closes on May 1, 2025. Don't miss this opportunity to be part of one of the premier sailing events in the Black Sea region.

new-training-program.title: New Training Program Launched
new-training-program.description: We're launching a comprehensive training program designed for sailors of all levels, from beginners to advanced competitors.
new-training-program.body:
Our new training program offers structured learning paths for sailors at every stage of their journey. The program includes:

- Beginner courses covering sailing fundamentals
- Intermediate training focusing on racing techniques
- Advanced coaching for competitive sailors
- Safety and navigation workshops

Classes are conducted by experienced instructors with international certifications. Flexible scheduling options are available to accommodate different needs.

Enrollment is now open for the spring session. Contact us for more information and to reserve your spot.

winter-season-update.title: Winter Season Update
winter-season-update.description: An update on our winter activities, maintenance schedule, and preparations for the upcoming sailing season.
winter-season-update.body:
As we wrap up the 2024 season, we want to share updates on our winter activities and preparations for 2025.

Maintenance and improvements:
- Complete fleet inspection and maintenance
- Dock facilities upgrades
- Safety equipment updates
- New equipment acquisitions

Winter activities:
- Indoor training sessions
- Rules and regulations workshops
- Planning meetings for 2025 events
- Social gatherings for members

We're looking forward to an exciting 2025 season and thank all members for their continued support.

championship-results-2024.title: 2024 Championship Results Published
championship-results-2024.description: The results from the 2024 championship series are now available. Congratulations to all participants and winners!
championship-results-2024.body:
We're pleased to announce the publication of the 2024 Championship Results. This year's competition featured outstanding performances across all categories.

Overall winners:
- First place: [Team/Sailor Name]

Category winners and detailed results are available on our results page. We extend our congratulations to all participants for their dedication and sportsmanship throughout the season.

Thank you to all competitors, volunteers, and supporters who made the 2024 championship series a success.

safety-guidelines-update.title: Updated Safety Guidelines
safety-guidelines-update.description: Important updates to our safety guidelines and procedures to ensure the well-being of all participants.
safety-guidelines-update.body:
We have updated our safety guidelines to align with the latest international standards and best practices. All participants are required to familiarize themselves with these updates.

Key changes:
- Enhanced weather monitoring procedures
- Updated emergency response protocols
- New equipment requirements
- Revised communication procedures

Safety briefings will be mandatory for all events. Please review the updated guidelines on our website and contact us if you have any questions.

Safety is our top priority, and we appreciate your cooperation in maintaining the highest standards.
